title: Russia's Nuclear Satellite Warning, Ebola Passes 11,000 Cases, India-US Trade Deal Near | Daily Crux
description_html:
Western intelligence fears Russia is preparing to launch a nuclear-armed satellite, Ebola in Congo has passed 11,000 cases, and India says its trade deal with America is in the last stretch. So how worried should you be? Today's three main stories explain what is known, what is not, how each story affects you wherever you live, and what you should do. Plus world headlines from Iran, Estonia, Ukraine, Britain, the Pacific and Africa, and a tough Monday for Indian markets.

Sources
According to official reports and statements: NDR, WDR and Sueddeutsche Zeitung investigation (reported), Kremlin and Russian embassy statements, US Defense Intelligence Agency, 1967 Outer Space Treaty (UN), Durham University, World Health Organization, Congo government data, Ministry of External Affairs (India) statements, US State Department, market data from the Bombay and National stock exchanges, International Energy Agency, World Food Programme, UK government, Estonian and Ukrainian governments, EU Commission.
